text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Race day. Yamanin Zephyr receives 
declarations of rivalry from Sakura 
Bakushin O and Nishino Flower, who pushed 
each other to greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr felt that competing against 
the two of them would allow her to become 
an even swifter wind, her heart racing. 
The second battle of the "Three-Division 
Sweep" begins...!
